title: GPT-6.1 Sol joins the model lineup
summary:
GPT-6.1 Sol, new audio SDK tools, a rebuilt app directory, and a fresh website shared the day with some necessary model housekeeping.

GPT-6.1 Sol was added with text and image input, tools, reasoning, a 1,050,000-token context window, and Quest Pollen access. Five video models now declare their fixed output resolutions, so requests specifying those resolutions are accepted. Amazon Nova Canvas and Reel were retired on September 30 with no replacement or fallback; generation requests using their IDs return 400. A FLUX.2 Max fallback billing fix charges for the image returned rather than the size requested, and generated API docs reflect the model-list changes.

The rebuilt Apps page adds a searchable directory, shareable filters and sorting, and a spotlight for the most-used Pollen Pay apps. Weekly rankings now credit catalog listings for successful, billable BYOP use instead of showing App Key redirect URLs. Search and filter changes no longer jump to the top of the page. Four community submissions joined the catalog, including a Godot 4 editor addon for text, image, and speech generation.

The SDK adds `audioTransform` for voice changing and voice isolation, while speech requests now send duration and seed and can include a reference-audio URL. Polli CLI 0.1.21 defaults nine managed harnesses to GPT-6 Sol without changing explicit model choices or existing local configurations. The computer MCP shell also preserves UTF-8 and binary bytes through file-writing commands; CLI and device-flow guides received corrections.

highlights.title: GPT-6.1 Sol added
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` for text and image input, tools, reasoning, and up to 1,050,000 tokens of context. It supports Quest Pollen accounts. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6.1-sol).

highlights.title: More audio in the SDK
highlights.text: Use `audioTransform` to send files to the voice changer or voice isolator. SDK speech requests can also include reference audio, duration, and seed. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol for harnesses
highlights.text: New Polli CLI configurations for nine managed coding harnesses now default to `openai/gpt-6-sol`. Explicit model choices and existing local configurations stay as they are. [Get Polli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: The Honey Census
highlights.text: Bought Pollen? The new public GitHub survey asks how you use it and what could work better. Eligible respondents can claim 10 Quest Pollen for a qualifying response.

highlights.title: A better app directory
highlights.text: Search community apps, filter by category, platform, or Pollen Pay, and sort by New or Popular. A weekly spotlight shows the most-used listed Pollen Pay apps. [Browse the apps](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: A new front door
highlights.text: The redesigned website brings apps, Quests, developer tools, and getting-started paths onto the homepage, with day/night artwork and community counts. [Take a look](https://pollinations.ai).
